title: Customer Accounts Management
description: Learn how to manage customer accounts, enable guest checkout, and configure account features.
content:
Customer Accounts Management

Customer accounts allow shoppers to save information, track orders, and manage their profile. Configure account settings to match your business needs.

Account Registration

Customers can create accounts:

  • During checkout
  • From store homepage
  • From login page
  • After placing an order (optional)

Account Features

Customer accounts include:

  • Order history
  • Order tracking
  • Saved addresses
  • Payment methods
  • Wishlist
  • Profile information
  • Account preferences

Guest Checkout

Allow customers to checkout without creating an account:

  • Enable/disable guest checkout
  • Optional account creation after order
  • Email-based order tracking
  • Faster checkout process

Account Registration Settings

Configure registration options:

  • Require email verification
  • Require account approval
  • Automatic account creation
  • Default customer role

Account Requirements

Set account requirements:

  • Minimum password strength
  • Required fields
  • Optional fields
  • Terms acceptance

Customer Profiles

Manage customer profile information:

  • Name and contact details
  • Billing address
  • Shipping address
  • Phone number
  • Date of birth
  • Preferences

Account Security

Security features for customer accounts:

  • Password reset
  • Email verification
  • Account lockout after failed logins
  • Two-factor authentication (if enabled)
  • Session management

Customer Communication

Communicate with customers through accounts:

  • Order notifications
  • Shipping updates
  • Promotional emails
  • Newsletters
  • Account-related emails

Account Dashboard

Customer account dashboard shows:

  • Recent orders
  • Order status
  • Account information
  • Quick links
  • Wishlist items

Managing Customer Accounts

As an admin, you can:

  • View customer accounts
  • Edit customer information
  • Reset passwords
  • Deactivate accounts
  • View order history
  • Add notes to accounts

Best Practices

  • Keep registration simple
  • Allow guest checkout
  • Offer incentives for account creation
  • Send welcome emails
  • Provide order tracking
  • Protect customer data
  • Comply with privacy regulations
